comment: profiles.get_asset results, methods_profiles.py:1029-1067. Frame 1 is the hit: {found, mime, size, data} where data is a FULL data: URL (`data:{mime};base64,{...}`, :1055-1062), not bare base64 — the payload here is a real 70-byte 1x1 RGBA PNG. Frame 2 is the miss: {found: false} and nothing else, returned as a SUCCESS rather than an error (:1064) so a roster can probe every row cheaply. Errors, when they do happen, are 4063 (name required) / 4064 (profile not found) / 5066. `asset` defaults to "avatar" and avatar is the only supported value.
